{{Quote|Are you embarking or what?''"<br />"''I'm waiting for my mates.''"<br />"''You shift your shiny silver backside now, I got a schedule.|The loadmaster and RC-1136|<ref name="RC:HC" />}}
A short, wrinkled [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] served as a '''loadmaster''' in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] and was stationed aboard the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] [[Implacable (Acclamator-class)/Legends|''Implacable'']]<ref name="RC:HC" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]'', which includes the appearance of the [[Duros]] loadmaster, in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. [[Standard hour/Legends|Hours]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], the loadmaster was directing [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]<ref name="RC:HC" /> on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] onto [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]], which were transporting the weary and wounded [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] onto the ''Implacable''.<ref name="RC:HC" />

While the ill-natured Duros barked commands at the troopers, he had a short exchange with [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Darman Skirata|RC-1136]] "Darman," who was waiting for his [[Theta Squad|squadmates]]. The loadmaster irritably ordered Darman aboard the gunships without his [[Squad/Legends|squad]], to which the [[Commando/Legends|commando]] responded by placing his [[Gauntlet vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] under the loadmaster's chin. After the exchange, the Duros quickly became submissive to the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]], referring to him as "sir" and treating him with a newfound deference.<ref name="RC:HC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The loadmaster appeared in the [[2004]] novel [[Republic Commando: Hard Contact|''Hard Contact'']], the first installment in the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' series written by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="RC:HC" />
